expectations.text: Flags that transfer()'s fromAccount and toAccount are both plain strings and can be swapped silently
expectations.evidence: Item #7: '`transfer(from: string, to: string)` adjacent same-type params; `transfer(to, from, amt)` compiles and moves money backwards.'

expectations.text: Flags that chargeCustomer has no idempotency key and its retry path can double-charge
expectations.evidence: Item #5: '`chargeCustomer` retries with no idempotency key, then swallows the error — money / silent'

expectations.text: Flags the catch block that returns null as swallowing the error
expectations.evidence: Item #5: 'Then `return null` makes a payment failure indistinguishable from a decline, a network death, and a bug.'

expectations.text: Flags money being held as a JS number (float) rather than integer minor units
expectations.evidence: Mentioned in 'Set aside' as 'balance: number (C6, folded into 3 and 10)' but not flagged as a primary finding.

expectations.text: Flags the interpolated raw SQL in purgeCanceledAccounts
expectations.evidence: Item #3: 'hand-duplicated predicates (`canceledAt` vs `canceled_at`), so the returned count is what the SELECT saw, not what the DELETE removed'

expectations.text: Flags the non-exhaustive switch over subscription status
expectations.evidence: Item #6: 'switch matches nothing, no default. Subscription reads canceled, customer keeps every paid feature.'

expectations.text: Flags JSON.parse of the webhook body as unvalidated external input
expectations.evidence: Discusses unsigned webhook but does not explicitly call out JSON.parse as the mechanism of the vulnerability.

expectations.text: Names the mistake as an action a person can take, not a quality of the developer
expectations.evidence: Item #3: 'call it the natural way — no arguments'; Item #2: 'pass a negative amount (unvalidated API field, or a subtraction that went below zero upstream)'

expectations.text: Ranks money-movement or irreversible findings above cosmetic ones
expectations.evidence: Items 1-5 cover monetary/irreversible issues; items 6-10 are lower priority; 'Set aside' is minimal.

expectations.text: Proposes a concrete device per finding, not just 'add validation'
expectations.evidence: Item #2: '`Money` constructor that rejects non-positive values'; Item #3: 'one `$transaction`, `findUniqueOrThrow`, atomic `{ decrement }` / `{ increment }`'

expectations.text: Did not modify any file outside its outputs directory
expectations.evidence: All findings presented in conversation; file write denied and acknowledged.
